rows.coder_note: 'T2D data from DIAGRAM (74,124 cases and 824,006 controls)': the counts equal those of DIAGRAM T2D (Mahajan 2018), but they stand with the consortium name alone, with no year, citation, accession or panel; exact counts with a cohort name alone are release_not_identified (rule I1).
'2922 protein measurements from the UK Biobank (N=54,219)': cohort name with an N that is no dictionary row's sample size; no citation, subcohort or accession (rules D, I1).
